no1-mattress.title: Nº1 Mattress
no1-mattress.desc: The Nº1 mattress is the ultimate in luxury, handmade in London.

no-2-mattress.title: Nº2 Mattress
no-2-mattress.desc: The iconic Nº2 luxury mattress has been a masterclass in craftsmanship, comfort, and style for over 100 years.

no-3-mattress.title: Nº3 Mattress
no-3-mattress.desc: Our dreamily deep Nº3 mattress is a prime example of the quality for which we are famed.

no-4-mattress.title: Nº4 Mattress
no-4-mattress.desc: Our Nº4 mattress was created following demand from some of the world’s best hotels.

no-4v-mattress.title: Nº4v Mattress
no-4v-mattress.desc: Our new Nº4 vegan mattress is handcrafted with natural, plant-based materials for the purest sleep imaginable.

no-5-mattress.title: Nº5 Mattress
no-5-mattress.desc: To create the ultimate foundation for self-care, each Nº5 mattress is handcrafted to order, in our Welsh Bedworks.

no-1-the-one.title: Nº1 - The One
no-1-the-one.desc: The culmination of over a century of bed-making expertise, requiring at least 120 hours of handcrafting, the Nº1 is the ultimate in luxury.

no-2-the-icon.title: Nº2 - The Icon
no-2-the-icon.desc: Commissioned for the Savoy hotel in 1905, the Nº2 is a masterclass in craftsmanship, comfort and style, taking over 80 hours to handcraft.

no-3-the-superior.title: Nº3 - The Superior
no-3-the-superior.desc: Nearly two weeks of skilled handcrafting and masses of the finest natural breathable materials go into our soft and sumptuous Nº3 bed.

no-4-the-new-standard.title: Nº4 - The New Standard
no-4-the-new-standard.desc: A masterpiece in longevity and comfort, our Nº4 bed model was created following demand from some of the finest hotels in the world.

no-4v-the-reformer.title: Nº4v - The Reformer
no-4v-the-reformer.desc: A recipe for better sleep. Our Nº4v is handcrafted from the finest plant-based materials, with no synthetic fillings, no animal products and minimal waste.

no-5-the-savvy.title: Nº5 - The Savvy
no-5-the-savvy.desc: Live fast, sleep slow. A bed for playing, for dreaming, for living. Made bespoke, for the everyday. The Savvy is our newest bed. Designed for real life.

horse-tail-wool-topper.title: Horse Tail & Wool Topper
horse-tail-wool-topper.desc: Our best-selling luxury topper, carefully crafted with masses of loose horse tail hair and soft sheep’s wool.

horse-tail-cashmere-wool-topper.title: Horse Tail & Cashmere Topper
horse-tail-cashmere-wool-topper.desc: A luxurious outer layer of pure cashmere is added to horse tail and wool before being fully encased in a high-tech cotton stretch fabric, bordered with our iconic Trellis ticking.

hair-cotton-topper.title: Hair & Cotton Topper
hair-cotton-topper.desc: Our newest addition to the range, the HC topper features an abundance of hand-teased loose hair, sandwiched between two layers of plush cotton .

cotton-wool-topper.title: Cotton & Wool Topper
cotton-wool-topper.desc: Loose cotton is sandwiched between generous layers of sheep’s wool to create our high quality CW topper.

vegan-topper.title: Cotton & Flax (Vegan) Topper
vegan-topper.desc: Our vegan topper, is handcrafted from plant-based materials and certified by The Vegan Society.

tengri-noble-fibres-horse-tail-topper.title: Khangai Yak & Horse Tail Topper
tengri-noble-fibres-horse-tail-topper.desc: Our sumptuous HKy topper comprises hand-laid Argentinian horse tail and Tengri’s exclusive Mongolian yak fibres, sourced from the Khangai Mountains.

white-siberian-goose-down-pillow.title: White Siberian Goose Down Luxury Pillow
white-siberian-goose-down-pillow.desc: An ultra-light and soft luxury pillow, perfect for front or back sleepers.

multi-tension-white-masurian-goose-down-.title: Multi-Tension White Masurian Goose Down Pillow
multi-tension-white-masurian-goose-down-.desc: A unique, multi-tension pillow comprising of three individual chambers filled with new white Masurian goose down, zipped into a soft, dust mite-proof outer casing.

canadian-goose-down-feather-luxury-pillo.title: White Canadian Goose Down & Feather Luxury Pillow
canadian-goose-down-feather-luxury-pillo.desc: A versatile luxury pillow filled with premium Canadian goose down and small feathers.

siberian-goose-down-feather-pillow.title: White Siberian Goose Down & Feather Luxury Pillow
siberian-goose-down-feather-pillow.desc: A firm tension pillow with a core of Siberian down and feathers, perfect for side sleepers.

hungarian-goose-down-and-feather-pillow.title: White Hungarian Goose Down & Feather Luxury Pillow
hungarian-goose-down-and-feather-pillow.desc: Natural luxury pillow filled with pure white Hungarian goose down and small feathers and encased in a 100% cotton dust mite-proof cover.
